comparison.objective: Extract a locked connector terminal, versus install a spring cage fastener into a rack opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert one blade beneath a recessed locking tab and pull tool and wire together, versus compress two retaining legs, pass both hooks through an opening, and release them behind a panel.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal exits without housing/crimp damage or neighboring release; versus fastener seated and retained, coupon unmoved, grippers released, and hold maintained.
comparison.reason: Both concern retention features, but one tests single-tab service extraction while the other tests bilateral spring compression and insertion; geometry alone is not the distinction.
